task.property_text: The Mako lexer parses any template in time roughly linear in its length.

property_clause.property: The Mako lexer parses any template in time roughly linear in its length.

environment.scope: The sqlalchemy/mako library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.parse(template_text: str, threshold_seconds: float = 2.0) parses `template_text` with Mako's Lexer, importing mako fresh, and times it; the returned outcome's `.exceeded` is True when CPU time passed the threshold. A test that shows the failure must pass a template that makes the lexer exceed the threshold.
